modelThreePromptPolicy: same frozen learned BC selection policy for PPO and warm-start; other prompts use explicit fixed helpers
selectionRule: Pin checkpoint, BC selection checkpoint, training recipe and source hashes before revealing any heldout outcome. Use development only for learning-signal checks and predeclared training stop/selection; never rerank or retrain from heldout results.
inference: CPU deterministic legal-candidate argmax; stable first-offered tie break
primaryComparison: PPO versus frozen BC warm-start: equal-weight mean terminal win indicator over the three opponents and both seats, paired within each heldout seed
uncertainty: Report each seed pair and opponent cell. Existing pairSummary paired-seed bootstrap (seed 1729, 10000 resamples) is descriptive only; four clusters can yield falsely narrow intervals. Also report distribution-free 95% Hoeffding bounds with seed clusters and score range [0,1], difference range [-1,1]. Missing terminal outcomes receive bounds [0,1] only for sensitivity, never imputed game labels.
improvementCriterion: All planned comparison cases naturally terminal with known winners, all provenance/privacy gates pass, and lower 95% distribution-free bound for paired PPO-minus-BC improvement is strictly positive. Otherwise inconclusive; a negative mean is an observed regression, not proof of population weakness. Four heldout seeds cannot meet this conservative superiority criterion; this is a baseline capacity pilot.
computeAdmission: Parent grants exclusive native-rollout window after checkpoint selection; no evaluation jobs during concurrent training collection.
